SpasiX — Setup & trading

SpasiX • BUILD 2026-10-27a • MetaTrader 5 (IC Markets) on Windows • LIVE • PROP • DEMO • BACKTEST

Updating to build 27a (3 minutes) — your open trades are safe

  • Close the old SpasiX (your positions stay open in MT5 with their stops and targets). Replace SpasiX.exe with the new one.
  • Copy the new SpasiXBridge.mq5 (v5) into MT5's MQL5\Experts folder (replace the old file) and restart MT5.
  • On the chart with the bridge: remove the old bridge (right-click → Expert list → Remove) and drag SpasiXBridge on again → tick Allow Algo Trading (Common tab) → OK.
  • Check the Algo Trading button in the MT5 toolbar is green. Start SpasiX: the start screen shows WELCOME BACK • N TRADES STILL OPEN → ⟳ RESUME LIVE (key R).

1First time only: the bridge in MT5

  • MT5 → File → Open Data Folder → MQL5 → Experts → paste SpasiXBridge.mq5 → restart MT5.
  • MT5 → Tools → Options → Expert Advisors → tick Allow WebRequest for listed URL → add http://127.0.0.1.
  • For deep backtest history: Tools → Options → Charts → Max bars in chart = Unlimited.
  • Drag SpasiXBridge onto ONE chart → tick Allow Algo Trading → OK. Start SpasiX.exe (first time: allow the .NET 8 Desktop Runtime; "Windows protected your PC" → More info → Run anyway).

2The start screen

  • 📈 LIVE your MT5 account • 🏆 PROP a CFD prop account with the firm's rules • 🎮 DEMO your MT5's live prices with a simulated account (your balance, RAW = no commission + wider spread, STANDARD = commission + spread near 0 — nothing reaches MT5) • 🧪 BACKTEST MT5's history replayed with its real ticks.
  • Several modes can be open at once: they are TABS in the title bar (⌂ HOME, ● LIVE, 🎮 DEMO, 🧪 BACKTEST, + opens another). ✕ on a tab closes that mode and returns HOME. The data (history, ticks, pool, settings) is kept on F:\SpasiX\MT5 when you have an F: drive (⚙ SETUP ▸ THE DATA FOLDER changes it). Keys 1 – 4 choose. The RESUME card (top right) shows the trades still open in MT5 and the saved DEMO. ⌂ MODES comes back here.

3The header and the chart

  • OPEN P/L big, its border pulses green / red • ▲ BUYS / ▼ SELLS: tickets • lots • P/L each, ★ = the side that leads • ⇅ HEDGED when both are open (net lots). Clocks: New York, London, Tokyo, MT5's server (+ the chart's zone) with the day.
  • Each instrument's tab shows its own P/L (and its chip in the toolbar). Every timeframe button counts down to its next candle.
  • 🎨 20 themes — MT5, MT5 Classic, MT5 Light, easy-on-the-eyes ones (Midnight Soft, Nordic Frost, Forest Calm, Solarized, Warm Dusk, Sepia Paper) and unique ones.
  • Mouse: wheel = zoom • drag the chart = move • drag the time axis: left = zoom in, right = zoom out • drag the price axis = stretch • double-click = back to now • right-click = the menu • F11 = full screen.

4Trading

  • All ✓ in the trade panel → one click on 🔓 ARM TRADING. Armed until DISARM or closing SpasiX.
  • SELL / BUY go in at once (LOTS, optional stop / target distance). The small ✕ on a ticket closes it at once.
  • Tickets look like MT5: buys and sells in their colours, drag a ticket line = set its stop / target, drag a stop / target to move it — on positions and on pending orders.
  • Right-click the chart → BUY / SELL LIMIT or STOP here → it asks the lots → PLACE.
  • Every close all (buys / sells / winners / losers / everything) asks first. ⚖ BREAKEVEN: every ticket in profit to its entry + points or $ (0 = the entry), this symbol or all — asks first.
  • 🧺 BASKET: close everything when the open P/L reaches +$X (e.g. +$350) or falls to −$Y — switched on with one confirmation, then it closes by itself once.
  • MaxLotsPerOrder in the bridge caps every order. EnableTrading = false makes SpasiX read only.

5🧪 Backtest studio

  • 📂 DATA: tick the symbols (gold, USTEC / NAS100, BTCUSD … together), the days (chips or FROM → TO), RAW (commission) or STANDARD (no commission, wider spread), the balance → ▶ START. It downloads MT5's 1-minute candles and real ticks once. ⓘ MT5 SPEC: contract, swap (its mode, triple day), margin per lot, hedged margin, your commission, spread.
  • Replay bar: ⏮ • ◀◀ DAY • ◀ CANDLE • ◀ 1m • ▶ PLAY • 1m ▶ • CANDLE ▶ • DAY ▶▶ • speed 1× … MAX • ⏩ London / NY open • 📅 GO TO a date + time or change the days. Keys: Space, ← → candle, Shift + ← → minute, Page Up / Down day. Going back keeps your trades before that moment.
  • ● REAL TICKS x % = how much of the replay moves exactly as MT5 recorded it.
  • 🗂 POOL: every finished day is saved in a TEST with all its numbers and trades; DAYS / WEEKS / MONTHS / YEARS; 🌐 HTML TRACKER (calendar, equity curve, tables, trades); ＋ NEW TEST keeps the old ones; 🧹 CLEAR asks first.

6🏆 PROP, 📊 TRACKER, 📰 NEWS

  • PROP: a preset (FTMO / The5ers / FundedNext / E8) or your firm's numbers; new entries are refused at a limit (closes always work).
  • TRACKER: calendar, weeks, win rate, profit factor, drawdown, equity curve, by hour / weekday / symbol, a journal per day.
  • NEWS: ⏭ UPCOMING (1 week ahead, up to 4) and ⏮ PAST, a sub-tab per day with its high-impact count; headlines on the right. 👁 STREAM blurs your name and number.

If something is not right

  • A red ✖ line in the trade panel names the switch that is off (usually the MT5 toolbar's Algo Trading or the bridge's Allow Algo Trading).
  • An order answered "✖ …" = MT5's own reason (market closed, invalid stops, not enough margin, …).
  • The real ticks, MT5's swap / margin per symbol need bridge v5 (⚙ SETUP shows the version).
